meta.method: Straight: call taken as posted. Inverted: same trigger, opposite side; target = original stop level, stop = original target level (no stop posted -> assumed 1R = target distance). Win = first touch of target before stop on 1-min bars (same-minute touch counts as stop). Entry: market at post, or limit/breakout touch of the stated level within 24h. Horizon ~5 trading days; no result -> open/expired (not counted). XAU/XAG = spot (HistData to 30 Oct 2026, then Yahoo GC=F/SI=F minus basis); MCX = spot x USDINR x calibration.
meta.caveat: Small samples; historical calls were extracted after the fact. IMPORTANT: the inverted mode was chosen BECAUSE chiragkb5/Cali_Xauusd lost in this history, so their historical inverted hit-rate is in-sample (flattering by construction) - only LIVE results are a fair test. Not investment advice.
